title: Pure D.D.
summary: Pure D.D. (Different Dimension) banish and removal strategy centered on classic banishing warriors and modern support, supported by generic staples. Led by D.D. Post, D.D. Seeker, and D.D. Survivor, the deck banishes opposing monsters in combat, disrupts the opponent's GY with D.D. Crow, and endlessly recurs its own banished monsters during each End Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: D.D. Post on activation banishes a card from either GY or field each turn, boosts all your monsters' ATK/DEF by 300 for each card type among your banished cards, and places itself back on the field when banished.
D.D. Seeker is a Quick Effect that targets and banishes 1 face-up monster you control until the End Phase of the next turn, dodging removal and triggering banish recursion.
D.D. Survivor returns to the field during the End Phase of the turn it was banished face-up from your field.
D.D. Scout Plane and D.D. Patrol Plane return to the field during the End Phase of the turn they were banished, providing infinite fodder.

summary.title: Opening: D.D. Post + D.D. Survivor
steps: Activate D.D. Post to start building banished card types and establish a stat boost.
Normal Summon D.D. Survivor (or D.D. Warrior Lady).
Use D.D. Post's effect to banish a card from your GY or field (such as D.D. Scout Plane).
Set defensive Spells and Traps to protect your board.
During the End Phase, trigger D.D. Scout Plane (and any banished D.D. Survivor) to Special Summon themselves back to your field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: D.D. Warrior Lady banishes both itself and any opponent's monster it battles after damage calculation, effortlessly removing untargetable or indestructible bosses.
D.D. Assailant banishes itself and any opponent's monster that destroys it by battle, punishing aggressive opponent attacks.
Dark Dimension Soldier is a Level 5 Synchro that banishes a card from hand to revive a banished DARK monster, and burns the opponent for each of their Set cards.
D.D. Crow is an iconic handtrap that banishes a card from the opponent's GY as a Quick Effect, shutting down GY-based combos.
D.D. Esper Star Sparrow prevents the opponent from targeting other monsters with attacks or effects, and Special Summons itself from the GY when the opponent declares a direct attack.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: D.D. Post acts as the engine anchor: banishing cards each turn, boosting ATK, and returning to the field whenever it is banished.
D.D. Dynamite inflicts 300 points of burn damage to the opponent for every single one of their banished cards, turning heavy banishing into sudden lethal damage.

D.D. Sprite is a Level 1 Tuner that banishes a face-up monster you control to Special Summon itself, returning the banished monster during your next Standby Phase to enable Dark Dimension Soldier Synchro plays.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Macro Cosmos and Monarch hybrid variants are excluded to keep the list concentrated purely on authentic D.D. named cards.
